---
# DP2 (New Innovator) Research Strategy — used instead of
# 04-research-strategy.qmd, which is the R01-style Significance / Innovation /
# Approach triad. _quarto-dp2.yml selects this file.
#
# DP2 is judged on the INVESTIGATOR and the IDEA, not on a detailed
# experimental plan. Preliminary data are explicitly NOT required and a
# conventional Aims-and-methods structure reads as a weak DP2. Write it as an
# essay: what could be true, why it would matter enormously, why you are the
# one to find out. VERIFY the page limit against the current RFA-RM.
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: 04-research-strategy-dp2.pdf
    number-sections: false
    top-level-division: section
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{titlesec}
        \setlength{\parskip}{4pt}

        % --- Figures -------------------------------------------------------
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{wrapfig}
        \usepackage{caption}
        \renewcommand{\figurename}{Fig.}
        \captionsetup{font=footnotesize, labelfont={bf, footnotesize}}
        \captionsetup[figure]{skip=2pt}
        \setlength{\textfloatsep}{6pt plus 2pt minus 2pt}

        % \rswrap{side}{width}{path}{caption} — see 04-research-strategy.qmd.
        % wrapfigure is LaTeX-only; pair it with a docx fallback.
        \newcommand{\rswrap}[4]{%
          \setlength{\columnsep}{6pt}%
          \setlength{\intextsep}{0pt}%
          \begin{wrapfigure}{#1}{#2}
          \centering
          \includegraphics[width=#2]{#3}
          \caption{#4}
          \end{wrapfigure}%
        }
  docx:
    output-file: 04-research-strategy-dp2.docx
---

# Research Strategy

## The Problem

The entrenched assumption or unsolved problem this program overturns. State
what the field currently believes and why that belief is the bottleneck.

## The Idea

The central hypothesis or approach, in a form a reviewer can restate after one
reading. This is the section the award turns on — it should be genuinely risky.
If it cannot fail, it is not a DP2.

## Why It Matters

What becomes possible if this is right. DP2 rewards a large payoff, so name the
downstream consequence for the field, not an incremental improvement.

## Approach

A high-level plan — direction and logic, not protocols. Show that the idea is
testable and that you have thought about what the first decisive experiment is.
Resist the urge to write an R01 Approach here; detail spent on methods is space
taken from the idea.

## Feasibility and Risk

The riskiest assumption, how you would know early if it is wrong, and where you
would go next. Reviewers want calibrated risk, not the absence of it.

## Why This Investigator

Track record, unique vantage point, and the environment that makes this
possible now. DP2 funds a person; make the case that this idea and this
investigator are not separable.

<!-- Preliminary data are NOT required for DP2 and are not expected. Include a
     figure only if it makes the idea legible faster than prose would. -->
